cards.name: Trebuchet
cards.description: Places mines in a diamond pattern on the opponent's field.

cards.name: Trebuchet Max
cards.description: Places mines in a large diamond pattern on the opponent's field.

cards.name: Bloodhound
cards.description: Clears and reveals all cells in a diamond area on your field.

cards.name: Bloodhound Max
cards.description: Clears and reveals all cells in a large diamond area on your field.

cards.name: Trebuchet Aimer
cards.description: Increases the power of the next Trebuchet, expanding its mine pattern.

cards.name: Trebuchet Aimer Max
cards.description: Greatly increases the power of the next Trebuchet, expanding its mine pattern.

cards.name: Erosion Dozer
cards.description: Clears up to 5 connected unrevealed cells starting from the target.

cards.name: Erosion Dozer Max
cards.description: Clears up to 5 connected unrevealed cells starting from the target with greater reach.

cards.name: Gravedigger
cards.description: Returns the last card from your discard pile to your hand.

cards.name: Zip Zap
cards.description: Chain lightning that defuses up to 3 mines on your field.

cards.name: Zip Zap Max
cards.description: Chain lightning that defuses up to 3 mines on your field with wider search radius.

cards.name: Opponent Bomb
cards.description: Reveals one cell on the opponent's field. If it's a mine, they take 1 damage.

cards.name: Flag Erase
cards.description: Removes all flags in a diamond area on the opponent's field.

cards.name: Flag Erase Max
cards.description: Removes all flags in a large diamond area on the opponent's field.

cards.name: Flag Reshuffle
cards.description: Randomly shuffles flags among cells in a diamond area on the opponent's field.

cards.name: Flag Reshuffle Max
cards.description: Randomly shuffles flags among cells in a large diamond area on the opponent's field.

cards.name: Smoke
cards.description: Covers cells in a diamond area with smoke for 3 rounds, hiding their contents.

cards.name: Smoke Max
cards.description: Covers cells in a large diamond area with smoke for 3 rounds, hiding their contents.

cards.name: Medic
cards.description: Restores 1 HP. Cannot exceed maximum health.

cards.name: Minefield Scout
cards.description: Reveals a line of cells on your field. Mines get flagged instead of exploding.

cards.name: Minefield Scout Max
cards.description: Reveals a longer line of cells on your field. Mines get flagged instead of exploding.

cards.name: Siphon
cards.description: Drains 1 mana from the opponent and adds it to yours.

cards.name: Chain Reaction
cards.description: Chains through up to 3 mines on the opponent's field, jumping to the nearest mine each time, and spawns additional mines around each in a diamond pattern.

cards.name: Overclock
cards.description: Grants +2 extra actions this turn. Does not carry over to the next turn.

cards.name: Fog of War
cards.description: Hides mine numbers on revealed cells in a diamond area for 2 rounds.

cards.name: Fog of War Max
cards.description: Hides mine numbers on revealed cells in a large diamond area for 2 rounds.

cards.name: Mobilization
cards.description: Draws 2 cards from the deck into your hand, ignoring the hand limit.

cards.name: Hand Scramble
cards.description: Returns all cards in the opponent's hand to their deck, shuffles it, and redraws the same number.

cards.name: Lockdown
cards.description: Reduces the opponent's maximum actions per turn by 1 for 2 rounds.

cards.name: Sonar
cards.description: Automatically flags all mines in a diamond area on your field without revealing any cells.

cards.name: Purge
cards.description: Removes all enemy effects (Smoke, Fog) from your entire field.

cards.name: Adrenaline
cards.description: Grants +1 extra action this turn.

cards.name: Mana Surge
cards.description: Grants +3 temporary mana this turn. Temporary mana does not carry over.

cards.name: Blood Pact
cards.description: Sacrifice 1 HP to gain +3 temporary mana and +2 extra actions this turn.

cards.name: Coin Toss
cards.description: Flip a coin: heads grants +2 actions, tails costs 1 action.

cards.name: Mana Fountain
cards.description: Roll a d5: gain 1-5 temporary mana this turn.

cards.name: Focus
cards.description: Your next card costs 1 less mana (minimum 0).

cards.name: Shield
cards.description: Absorbs the next mine hit, preventing 1 HP damage.

cards.name: Power Surge
cards.description: All cards cost 1 less mana this turn (minimum 1).

cards.name: Embargo
cards.description: All opponent's cards cost 1 more mana for their next turn.

cards.name: Recycler
cards.description: Discard 1 card from your hand, then draw 2 cards from your deck.

cards.name: Mystic Draw
cards.description: Flip a coin: heads draws 2 cards, tails returns 2 random cards to deck.

cards.name: Double or Nothing
cards.description: Flip a coin: heads doubles your current mana, tails sets it to 0.

cards.name: Gambler's Ruin
cards.description: Flip a coin: heads gives +3 cards and +2 mana, tails discards 2 random cards.

cards.name: Excavator
cards.description: Clears a cross-shaped area: flags mines and reveals safe cells.

cards.name: Excavator Max
cards.description: Enhanced excavator with a larger cross-shaped area.

cards.name: Thermal Vision
cards.description: Temporarily highlights all mines in a diamond area this turn without flagging.

cards.name: Thermal Vision Max
cards.description: Enhanced thermal vision with a larger detection area.

cards.name: Chaos Diamond
cards.description: Random Bloodhound: clears a diamond of random size (2-5), flagging mines and revealing safe cells.

cards.name: Chaos Scout
cards.description: Random scout line of length 3-7, flagging mines and revealing safe cells.

cards.name: Mine Cluster
cards.description: Plants mines in a cross pattern on the opponent's field.

cards.name: Mine Cluster Max
cards.description: Enhanced mine cluster with a larger cross pattern.

cards.name: Carpet Bomb
cards.description: Plants mines in a line of 5 on the opponent's field.

cards.name: Carpet Bomb Max
cards.description: Enhanced carpet bomb with a longer mine line.

cards.name: Fortune Blast
cards.description: Random trebuchet: plants mines in a diamond of random size (1-4) on the opponent's field.

cards.name: Chaos Fog
cards.description: Random smoke: covers opponent's field with fog in a diamond of random size (1-4) for 3 rounds.

cards.name: Frost
cards.description: Freezes the opponent, preventing them from opening cells for 1 round.

cards.name: Frost Max
cards.description: Enhanced frost that freezes the opponent for 2 rounds.

cards.name: Blackout
cards.description: Covers the opponent's entire board with fog for 1 round.

cards.name: Blackout Max
cards.description: Enhanced blackout that covers the opponent's board with fog for 2 rounds.

cards.name: Fortune Cookie
cards.description: Draw a random card from the deck.

cards.name: Salvage
cards.description: Recover a previously used card from the discard pile.

cards.name: Card Thief
cards.description: Steal a random card from the opponent's hand.

cards.name: Sabotage Deck
cards.description: Insert a dud card into the opponent's deck.

cards.name: Dud
cards.description: A useless card that does nothing when played.

cards.name: Soul Link
cards.description: Link with the opponent: any damage they take, you also receive.

cards.name: Mirror Match
cards.description: Copy the last card the opponent played.

cards.name: Dimension Rift
cards.description: Shuffle the positions of all open cells on the opponent's board.
